name: Heavy Metal Fabrication & Welding
old_description: Where precision meets strength. Mobile welding & custom metal fabrication experts ready to spark life into your project with professionalism and superior customer service.
about:
Heavy Metal Fabrication & Welding operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, where it was founded in 2021 by James Craft. The business began as a mobile welding service and has since expanded to two locations in the area, operating as a limited liability partnership.

The shop provides mobile welding and custom metal fabrication, including structural, MIG, and TIG welding performed on-site. Its fabrication work covers brackets, frames, gates, railings, and custom industrial components, while its repair and maintenance division handles trailers, equipment, and metal structures. The mobile team brings welding equipment directly to job sites across the region.

The company serves construction, agricultural, and industrial clients in and around Colorado Springs, with projects ranging from ornamental metalwork to structural repairs for heavy equipment and trailers. Customers include property owners, contractors, and operators needing on-site welding or custom-built metal components.

Craft, who brings over a decade of hands-on welding experience, established the business on a philosophy of showing up, doing excellent work, and treating every client with respect. The company emphasizes clear communication, adaptability to each project’s needs, and standing behind its workmanship.
